column1: # The pictures UI-9a turned into icons (tools/Convert-PictureUses.ps1 -Apply writes this file; docs/port-notes/UI-9a.md).

# how: Icon (UI.Button.Icon, the 22 px slot drawn as vectors), GetBitmap (IconLibrary.GetBitmap at the picture's 96 DPI size) or UiIcons (CodeBase.UiIcons.GetBitmap by name, OpenPmsDentalGraph and OpenPmsDentalBusiness, converted by hand); since UI-9b, ImageList (a picture of a toolbar's designer ImageList, now the icon at its index in the list IconLibrary.GetImageList builds: the file's ArrayIconsImageList, given to the control's SetImageListIcons; written by hand).

# UI-9b-3 (docs/port-notes/UI-9b.md, section 4): property ArrayIcons...[<index>] is the icon at the index of the file's array (a tree or list built by IconLibrary.GetImageList / GetImageListForSize); GetBitmap rows are buttons' 16 px pictures.
